review_claim: The paired coding evaluator records externally checked results for one real-code experiment.
safety_invariant: Experimental edits stay in isolated copies; product code and live state are unchanged, and grading answers are inaccessible to trial agents.
task_prompt: Edit this repository only. In WorkflowMutationFacade retryTask handling, preserve workflow-review cleanup when retrying a qualified task id after the task record is unavailable. If retryTask is called with an id like wf-1/task-a and orchestrator.getTask(taskId) returns undefined, close the workflow review for wf-1 before routing through commandService.retryTask. Do not close an arbitrary workflow for an unqualified missing task id such as task-a. Add or update focused tests, run the relevant tests if possible, and do not commit, publish, or change files outside the repository.
later_protocol: Run six predeclared real-code tasks, five randomized baseline/treatment pairs per task, no retries beyond the idempotent ledger, and publish only sanitized diffs, grader outcomes, pinned runner config, and aggregate statistics.
